verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong, readable headline block with 17–24 next to it, but 'Speakers:' sits alone beside the headline while the speaker names and address are shrunk to illegible micro-text far right. 'FEBRUARY' is cut off from 17–24 under a meaningless grey panel, and the pink bars and C graphic are reduced to debris. B is worse: the speaker list is split into two groups at opposite ends of the banner, and 'FEBRUARY' sits bottom-left, far from '17–24'. The venue name is tiny and wedged above the headline, the address floats mid-right, and fragments of the C graphic clutter the bottom, so the hierarchy and grouping fall apart.
